chapters.title: Riverglades: the Farholde loose ends
chapters.note: Starts where chapter 41 ends: Farholde Keep, hearth bound there. The Farholde quests left at level 40-42, the three Krol'dok lead-ins that are done outside the instance, and the pickups for later chapters: Friz Frazzlespark's three errands at Powderfuse Port (I Know a Guy to Booty Bay, Shipping and Handling to Steamwheedle Port, From Port to Port to Feathermoon), The Twilight Threat for Stormwind, Delivering Closure if the Field Marshal's Log chain was done, and the Krol'dok dungeon quests at Demar Brant and Sergeant Riftan. News to Farholde has no prerequisite in the DB although its giver's other quest is the elite Bring Me His Head: unverified that he offers it alone.

chapters.title: Krol'dok Stronghold (dungeon)
chapters.note: Required dungeon chapter, one run. The DB has no mob levels, ranks or positions for the instance; the quests are level 41-45, so 43 is a placeholder the spec settles from Wowhead's zone page. Vengeance of the Highborne is given by Ranath Nightstride at the Dalaran crater (Alterac 17.8,66.0): the chapter opens with the Ironforge training stop (level 42 row) and the Southshore flight to fetch it before the run. Tome of Twilight and Eye of Mugg hang on one boss each; Twilight Mementos is a trash collection at 11% and is grind / luck.

chapters.title: Badlands and Aerie Peak
chapters.note: From Ironforge: fly Thelsamar, ride into the Badlands for the level 40-43 leftovers (Tremors of the Earth is Boss Tho'grun, Normal on Wowhead; its follow-up against Blacklash and Hematus is the one elite quest kept, optional, for the Prismscale Hauberk), then Ironforge - Aerie Peak for Falstad's hand-in and the first Hinterlands pickups. Artisan Leatherworking at Drakk Stonehand (skill 200, 5g) falls here if the skill is there. Whether the trip to Aerie Peak waits for chapter 49 depends on question 3 (the Kalimdor Kocktail).

chapters.title: Stormwind, the Temple door and Booty Bay
chapters.note: Stormwind hand-ins from the Riverglades, Brohann Caskbelly's In Search of The Temple (fly Nethergarde, ride to the Pool of Tears in the Swamp of Sorrows, back to Stormwind), the Nethergarde supply run from Darkshire, then Booty Bay: Friz's caravan chain with Caravaneer Ruzzgot and Raptor Mastery's third part. The chapter ends on the Booty Bay - Ratchet boat.

chapters.title: Tanaris I
chapters.note: Gadgetzan and Steamwheedle Port, quest levels 40-46. Gadgetzan's flight point is not known yet: the first trip is by road from Ratchet through the Barrens and the Shimmering Flats (the Great Lift was used in chapter 39; the road is unverified). Bind at Gadgetzan. Friz's Steamwheedle chain, the Wastewander and Southsea quests, the two WANTED posters, and the Screecher Spirits pickup for Feralas. Artisan Cooking (Clamlette Surprise at Dirge Quikcleave, Cooking 225, level 35) is a gate stop here.

chapters.title: Feralas I
chapters.note: Feathermoon Stronghold, quest levels 41-45. First trip by road: Gadgetzan - Thousand Needles - Thalanaar (flight point) - through Feralas to the Forgotten Coast boat (unverified). The naga and Gordunni quests, the Missing Courier chain, OOX-22/FE, Friz's delivery and the screecher spirits. It comes before Zul'Farrak because The Prophecy of Mosh'aru needs Screecher Spirits handed in first.

chapters.title: Zul'Farrak (dungeon)
chapters.note: Required dungeon chapter, one run: Thalanaar - Gadgetzan by flight, Screecher Spirits handed in at Steamwheedle Port on the way. Mobs inside are level 43-48 in the DB and every boss is ranked elite there. Six quests hang on one boss each (Wowhead reads 12-43% over all kills, quest or not) and are labelled normal with a one-kill note. Troll Temper (16% from the trolls) is grind / luck. Gahz'rilla has to be summoned and is optional.

chapters.title: Powderfuse return and the Hinterlands
chapters.note: Back east: Gadgetzan - Theramore by flight, the Menethil boat, Ironforge for the level 44 training row and the Uldum and Tymor pickups at the Explorers' League. Farholde Keep by flight from Thelsamar and the ride to Powderfuse Port for Friz's two hand-ins and the Booty Bay parcel, then Aerie Peak. Both Jintha'Alor quests are out: Vile Priestess Hexx and the Ancient Egg's guards are level 51 elites in the DB.

chapters.title: Searing Gorge
chapters.note: Thorium Point's flight point is not known: the first trip is on foot (which pass is open on Forever is unverified). The board and Thorium Brotherhood quests with normal targets, the Suntara Stones, and Caught! / The Key to Freedom. The Kalaran Windblade chain stops where its targets turn elite.

chapters.title: Stranglethorn: the Cape
chapters.note: Booty Bay again on the way to Kalimdor: The Bloodsail Buccaneers (the captains run to level 48), Stranglethorn Fever (Mokk the Savage, Normal on Wowhead), Cortello's Riddle, Whiskey Slim's Lost Grog and Message in a Bottle, then the Ratchet boat. Where Cortello's later clues lie, and whether they fit this pass, is for the spec.

chapters.title: Feralas II
chapters.note: Feathermoon by flight now (Ratchet - Theramore - Thalanaar - Feathermoon). Quest levels 46-51: the Writhing Deep, the Sprite Darter chain (it ends in Darnassus, Thousand Needles and the Hinterlands: the spec says how far it goes here), the Feathermoon library errands, the wandering giants, and The Sunken Temple lead-in for Tanaris.

chapters.title: Maraudon (dungeon)
chapters.note: Required dungeon chapter, entered from Desolace (Feathermoon - Nijel's Point flight). Mobs inside are level 43-51 in the DB, so it sits at 47-48 and the spec decides whether the outer wings and the inner falls are one run or two, the way Scarlet Monastery was split. The Shadowshard Fragments (46%) and the Theradric Crystal Carvings (27%) are collections and are grind / luck.

chapters.title: Tanaris II and Uldum
chapters.note: Gadgetzan by flight (Nijel's Point - Theramore - Gadgetzan). Quest levels 47-51: the Dunemaul compound (Gor'marok, Normal on Wowhead), Thistleshrub Valley, the Gahz'ridian ornaments, Tooga, OOX-17/TN, the egg-o-matic, The Stone Circle, and the Uldum pedestal for the Explorers' League chain. The silithid chain (Noxious Lair Investigation and the four quests behind it) is question 2.

chapters.title: Azshara
chapters.note: Talrendis Point, new on Forever; its flight point is not known, so the first trip is by road from Astranaar (unverified). Quest levels 47-55. The Talrendis, coast and Ravencrest quests are in QuestieDB with Alliance givers. The two furbolg chains at Ursolan (15 quests) are not in QuestieDB and their Wowhead pages state no side: they are listed as conditional and not counted. Tymor's Arcane Runes and the Dragonscale Leatherworking quest at Peter Galen (37.6,65.4; Leatherworking 225) are done here.

chapters.title: Un'Goro Crater
chapters.note: Marshal's Refuge, reached on foot from Gadgetzan (flight point taken there). The stretch chapter: its quests are level 50-55 and several run to level 54-55 mobs. The pylons, It's a Secret to Everybody, the journal and crate finds and the Lar'korwi quests are placed first; the level 50 pickups come last. If he is under 49 on arrival, the Ursolan chains and the two chains from questions 2 and 3 come first.

chapters.title: Level 50: Ironforge
chapters.note: Closing stop of the round: the level 46, 48 and 50 training rows not yet bought, the Explorers' League hand-ins for the Uldum and Tymor chains, the profession ranks still open, and a check with Eldrun for a level-50 class quest (the Classic ones are Horde-side on Wowhead).
